gitea_integration.description: Validate work items and link Git commits across repositories in this workspace.
gitea_integration.steps: Enable the integration → Generate Hook code → Copy into the Gitea Git Hooks editors
gitea_integration.generation_help: Generate once per workspace and reuse across repositories. The code detects the repository at runtime; no repository or API addresses to enter.
gitea_integration.hook_requirements: Uses sh, Git, curl and standard tools included in official Gitea images. No Python or jq installation is needed.
gitea_integration.hook_installation: Copy each script into its matching editor under Gitea repository Settings → Git Hooks, then save.
gitea_integration.pre_receive_help: Validates work item identifiers before accepting a push; failed validation rejects it.
gitea_integration.post_receive_help: Reports commits after a successful push to link work items automatically.
gitea_integration.hook_help: Code contains the workspace key. Share only with repository administrators.
gitea_integration.rotate_warning: Rotation immediately invalidates the old key. Regenerate and replace Hook code in every connected repository before pushing again.
gitea_integration.rotated: Workspace key rotated. Regenerate and replace Hook code in every connected repository.
gitea_integration.disable_warning: Disabling affects all repositories using this workspace key. Validation hooks will reject pushes until their code is removed or replaced.
gitea_integration.disabled_notice: Disabled. Remove or replace Hook code in connected repositories before pushing.
gitea_integration.action_error: The action failed. Check workspace permissions and connectivity, then retry.
gitea_integration.load_error: Could not load Git integration data. Please retry.
gitea_integration.empty_commits: No linked Git commits yet. Successfully reported commit links appear here automatically.
gitea_integration.author: Author

feishu_integration.name: Feishu
feishu_integration.nickname_help: Card names prefer Feishu nicknames. Enable Get basic information in contacts and Obtain user's basic information for the relevant people. Unavailable names are labelled accordingly and never fall back to SSO nicknames.
feishu_integration.description: Send application bot direct-message cards for work item field changes, comments, and related activity. Reassignment and state handoffs notify both previous and new assignees. Cards link to work item details.
feishu_integration.secret_stored: Secret stored — leave blank to keep
feishu_integration.secret_help: The saved secret is never displayed. Enter a new secret when changing applications.
feishu_integration.app_id_required: Enter an App ID before enabling notifications.
feishu_integration.secret_required: Enter this application's secret before enabling notifications.
feishu_integration.load_error: Could not load Feishu configuration. Retry to configure this integration.
feishu_integration.action_error: The action failed. Check your configuration and connection, then try again.
feishu_integration.identification_help: Recipients are identified automatically using the mobile number synced at SSO login. Only a masked number is shown. Ask members to sign in again through SSO after phone synchronization is deployed. Missing, invalid, or unmatched numbers are skipped with a reason in delivery history. Save and enable the integration before sending a test.
feishu_integration.recipients_error: Could not load recipient identification. Use Refresh to try again.
feishu_integration.save_first: Save configuration changes before sending test cards.
feishu_integration.test_queued: Test card queued. This does not confirm delivery; refresh delivery history to check its result.
feishu_integration.delivery_help: Latest 50 deliveries. Status updates only when you refresh; queued messages require a running Celery worker.
feishu_integration.deliveries_error: Could not load delivery history. Use Refresh to try again.

delivery_error.phone_missing: Skipped: no SSO mobile is available. Correct your SSO phone claims and sign in again.
delivery_error.phone_invalid: Skipped: the SSO mobile format is invalid. Check the phone and country code in your identity provider.
delivery_error.phone_not_found: Skipped: no Feishu account matched the mobile. Check the account's phone, app contact access, and availability range.
delivery_error.phone_ambiguous: The mobile matched multiple accounts. Resolve the duplicate identity before sending.
delivery_error.phone_changed: The recipient's mobile changed after this message was queued.
delivery_error.phone_conflict: The mobile conflicts with another account. Resolve the identity conflict before sending.
delivery_error.phone_inactive: Skipped: the Feishu account is disabled, resigned, or not activated.
delivery_error.recipient_inactive: The recipient is no longer an active workspace member.
delivery_error.issue_unavailable: The work item is no longer available.
delivery_error.project_membership_inactive: The recipient is no longer an active project member.
delivery_error.secret_decryption_failed: Could not decrypt the saved app secret. Save the secret again.
delivery_error.provider_rejected: Feishu rejected the request. Check app permissions and recipient visibility.
delivery_error.delivery_failed: The message could not be sent.
delivery_error.attempt_limit: The maximum number of sending attempts was reached.
